models_evaluated: 3D deep learning model for cerebral microbleed detection and localization

links.outcome: Reader sensitivity per lesion and false positives per patient with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: Sensitivity with AI vs without: reader 1 0.991 vs 0.905 (p=0.132), reader 2 0.922 vs 0.621 (p=0.017), reader 3 0.966 vs 0.871 (p=0.227). FPs per patient did not differ significantly.
links.quote: In particular, radiology residents (reader 2) showed a statistically significant increase in sensitivity per lesion when using AI.

screen.reason: The study conducts a reader study comparing diagnostic performance of clinicians with versus without AI assistance for detecting cerebral microbleeds.

primary.practice: AI assistance in clinician image interpretation
